S.TRANSL: Mother asked Father to drink water.

S.FORM: Papikaenen aku ci panay tu pawli
Papikaenen aku ci panay tu pawli
S.PHON: papikaənən aku ʦi panaj tu pawɾi
S.TRANSL: I asked Panay to eat banana.
I ask Panay to run.
I ask Panay to join a race.
I will definitely ask Panay to run.
I will definitely make Panay join the race.
Bring the box in!
Bring the child in!

TRANSL.notes: The causee is a little child.

S.TRANSL: Walk with him!
Drive this car!
Make this car run!
Ask him to go to walk!

S.FORM: Papinengnengen ni ina ku wawa tu wacu
Papinengnengen ni ina ku wawa tu wacu
S.PHON: papinəŋnəŋən ni ina ku wawa tu waʦu
S.TRANSL: Mother will ask the child to watch the dog.

S.FORM: Paaca kaku tu cudad i wawa
Paaca kaku tu cudad i wawa
S.PHON: paaʦa kaku tu ʦuɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮ i wawa
S.TRANSL: I am going to the child's place to sell the book.
I sell the book to the child.

S.FORM: Paaca kaku tu cudad i ci akian
Paaca kaku tu cudad i ci akian
S.PHON: paaʦa kaku tu ʦuɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮ i ʦi akian
S.TRANSL: I sold the book to Aki.

S.FORM: Mapacakay ni aki ku futing ci ofadan
Mapacakay ni aki ku futing ci ofadan
S.PHON: mapaʦakaj ni aki ku futiŋ ʦi o~ufaɬ~ɮan
S.TRANSL: Aki sold (other people's) fish to Ofad.

S.FORM: Mapaaca nura wawa ku hana tura kaying
Mapaaca nura wawa ku hana tura kaying
S.PHON: mapaaʦa nura wawa ku ħana tura kajiŋ
S.TRANSL: That child sold flowers to that lady.

S.FORM: Pafli ci mayaw ci akian tu paysu
Pafli ci mayaw ci akian tu paysu
S.PHON: pafɾi ʦi majaw ʦi akian tu pajsu
S.TRANSL: Mayaw is going to give money to Aki.

S.FORM: Mapafli aku tu paysu ci mayaw
Mapafli aku tu paysu ci mayaw
S.PHON: mapafɾi aku tu pajsu ʦi majaw
S.TRANSL: I gave the money to Mayaw already.

S.FORM: Mapafli aku ku payau ci mayawan
Mapafli aku ku payau ci mayawan
S.PHON: mapafɾi aku ku pajau ʦi majawan
S.TRANSL: I gave the money to Mayaw.
Don't give the child!

S.FORM: Pacaliw ci panay ci akian tu paliding
Pacaliw ci panay ci akian tu paliding
S.PHON: paʦaɾiw ʦi panaj ʦi akian tu paɾiɬ~ɮiŋ
S.TRANSL: Panay lent the car to Aki.

S.FORM: Mapacaliw ni kacaw ku singsi tu paysu
Mapacaliw ni kacaw ku singsi tu paysu
S.PHON: mapaʦaɾiw ni kaʦaw ku siŋsi tu pajsu
S.TRANSL: Kacaw lent the teacher money.

S.FORM: Mapacaliw ni kacaw ku paysu i singsi
Mapacaliw ni kacaw ku paysu i singsi
S.PHON: mapaʦaɾiw ni kaʦaw ku pajsu i siŋsi
S.TRANSL: Kacaw lent the money to the teacher.
I don't want to add water into the soda.
I don't want to add water into the soda.

S.FORM: Mapananum tu ni ina ku sayta i wawa
Mapananum tu ni ina ku sayta i wawa
S.PHON: mapananum tu ni ina ku sajta i wawa
S.TRANSL: Mother gave soda for the child to drink.

S.FORM: Paneneneng kaku tunini a tilid ci sawmahan
Paneneneng kaku tunini a tilid ci sawmahan
S.PHON: panənənəŋ kaku tunini a tiɾiɬ~ɮ ʦi sawmaħan
S.TRANSL: I am going to show the letter to Sawmah.
Let me see the pencil!
Tear the paper apart and give Aki a portion!
Tear the paper!
Break the steam bun into halves and give one half to the child.
